lead: Follow the project from product selection and artwork through samples, production and packing. The manufacturing route depends on the chosen material, component and decoration.
html:
Existing models and new shapes take different routes

An existing model starts with its current specification. A new cup shape adds structure development and tooling before the sample and production stages.

Use a controlled handoff

Keep the approved artwork, model, material, finish and packing in one production reference. A process illustration explains the route; the project schedule belongs to the actual order.
